Record the person responsible and assembly date or shift.
List the parts and material group entering the operation.
State the face, edge, datum, drawing note, or tolerance used.
Example: Front edges flush / diagonals within 1 mm

What to record: Record mating part IDs, face, edge, centerline, and joint number.
Example: J12 / A faces out / top reference

What to record: Record cutter or drill size, depth, width, offset, spacing, and machine mode.
Record insertion, bottoming, lateral play, face alignment, and square.
